_about: MCP servers for this kit. Intentionally EMPTY. See mcp/CATALOG.md before adding anything.
_why_empty: Every MCP server is a new authorization surface and a new supply-chain dependency. Enabling one requires two visible edits: an entry here, AND its host added to the engagement's containment.json egress allowlist. A connector nobody decided to add is a connector nobody reviewed.
_recommended_if_needed: Filesystem (read-only, scoped to the source directory) is the closest match to the built-in adapter. Do NOT enable Fetch: it is an egress capability and it hands back the kit's central injection defence. Do NOT enable Memory: sources are canonical, and a separate mutable memory becomes a second unsourced authority.
